messages:
tess: Quick flag from the int4 bring-up on the low-latency reranker: NDCG@10 is within noise, but MRR@1 on the short-query cohort is down ~0.055. Noted on run id rb-2026-03-19-07.

omar: ouch. short-query cohort = queries < 20 tokens? any candidate pool changes?

tess: yup short_queries (<20). candidate pool is identical (top150) and seed fixed. I dumped candidate-order hashes and attach diffs.

nina: did you run with the prod tokenizer and preproc? we had a tokenization tweak and a pad-to-8 change last sprint.

tess: offline harness accidentally used tokenizer: bpe-v1-experimental. prod uses bpe-v2-stable. also eval config had pad_len: 4 while prod pads to 8. both could interact with int4 quantized logits.

omar: padding difference + bpe shift could change token alignment and KV cache fragments for small context models 914. Do we see systematic shifts (doc moves up/down) or random churn?

tess: mostly top1 flips for short single-word queries. Example diff in tokens:
```
query: "reset"
prod tokens: ["re", "set"]
eval tokens: ["res", "et"]
```
That small split changes scoring enough to reorder candidates in many cases.

chris: additionally, int4 symmetric scaling can compress logits and change softmax tail behaviour. Did you check logit-scale calibration (temperature) in the quant run?

tess: good call. I compared pre-softmax logits between fp16 and int4 runs on a sample. median logit magnitude reduced ~0.12, variance also lower. I queued a run with temperature correction (temp=0.95) to see if MRR recovers.

zoe: please also run tokenizer parity (bpe-v2) with prod pad_len=8 but without temp correction, then with temp correction, to separate effects.

nina: also validate that HTML stripping change we made (normalize_html_whitespace=true) isn't collapsing tokens differently for single-word queries. tiny whitespace edits can trigger BPE merges.

eval-bot: artifacts for rb-2026-03-19-07 uploaded: https://storage.redwood-inference.test/evals/rb-2026-03-19-07 (artifacts: results.csv, token_diffs.csv, candidate_hashes.json). summary: ndcg@10 delta -0.003, mrr@1 delta -0.055.

tess: plan of action: (1) run tokenizer parity (bpe-v2) + pad=8 (no temp adj) -> expect most of the shift to be resolved, (2) run bpe-v2 + pad=8 + temp=0.95 correction -> should close remaining MRR gap if quant scaling is the issue, (3) if still failing, run ablation disabling html normalization to confirm its role. I'll post order-hash diffs for each run. ETA first two in ~90m.

omar: good. If tokenizer+pad fixes >80% of regression, we add a gating check: require tokenizer + padding parity in bring-up CI for quantized models.

chris: also capture topk per-query score deltas for the failed queries so we can see whether rank score margins shrink or flip.

zoe: tagging infra to make sure the eval harness picks up the correct tokenizer artifact version automatically; there's been several silent defaults lately. @infra-team

tess: noted. I'll open a small PR to pin tokenizer_version and pad_len in the eval config template and add a checksum assertion. will link PR in this thread when ready.

eval-bot: queued runs: rb-2026-03-19-07a (bpe-v2 pad8), rb-2026-03-19-07b (bpe-v2 pad8 temp0.95). expected finish ~90m.

tess: thanks all. I'll update when artifacts land. :coffee:
